name: Italian Sausage & Peppers
description: Juicy Italian sausages, sweet peppers, and silky onions, finished together in the oven. A little air-fryer help gets dinner moving while the vegetables soften.

components.name: The sausages
components.description: Pork Italian sausages, browned in the air fryer and finished in the oven.

components.name: Peppers & onions
components.description: A generous tangle of sweet peppers, onions, garlic, and oregano.

components.name: For the table
components.description: Soft rolls, or gluten-free buns if you prefer.

ingredients.name: Italian pork sausages
ingredients.preparation: About 4 oz each; sweet or hot

ingredients.name: Sandwich rolls
ingredients.preparation: Use gluten-free buns for a GF meal

events.title: Warm up and slice
events.instruction: Heat the oven to 375°F and preheat the air fryer to 375°F. Slice the peppers, onion, and garlic. Set out a shallow oven-safe baking dish large enough for the sausages in one layer.

events.title: Brown the sausages in the air fryer
events.instruction: Arrange the sausages in one layer with a little space between them. Air-fry for about 10 minutes, turning at 5 minutes. This browns the outside; the sausages will finish cooking in the oven. Use separate tongs for raw and cooked meat.

events.title: Soften the peppers and onions
events.instruction: Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add peppers and onions with salt and black pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 12–15 minutes.

events.title: Turn for even browning
events.instruction: Turn the sausages carefully and continue air-frying for about 5 minutes. Keep the vegetables moving in the skillet as needed.

events.title: Move the sausages to their tray
events.instruction: Transfer the browned, partly cooked sausages to the baking dish and put it straight into the oven while the peppers finish. Do not hold partly cooked sausages for later.
events.doneness: Italian pork sausages must reach 160°F / 71°C internally.

events.title: Bring everything together
events.instruction: Add garlic, oregano, and optional red pepper flakes to the skillet and stir for 1 minute. Pour in the stock and scrape up the browned bits. Carefully spoon the peppers and onions around the sausages in the oven dish; return it to the oven.

events.title: Check the center of each sausage
events.instruction: Check each sausage with an instant-read thermometer inserted into its center. Remove only when each reaches at least 160°F. If needed, bake for another 5 minutes and check again. Warm the rolls for the final few minutes, keeping any GF buns separate.
events.doneness: Pork sausages: 160°F / 71°C. Poultry sausage, if substituted: 165°F / 74°C.

events.title: Rest briefly and fill the rolls
events.instruction: Let the cooked sausages rest for a few minutes. Fill the warm rolls with a sausage and plenty of peppers and onions. Spoon over a little pan juice and add optional parsley.

notes: Use Italian pork sausages for the stated cooking target. If substituting chicken or turkey sausage, cook to 165°F / 74°C.
Air-fryer timing varies by model and sausage thickness. The browning stage is not a doneness test; verify every sausage with a thermometer.
For a gluten-free meal, choose labeled GF sausages and stock, use GF buns, and avoid cross-contact with ordinary bread.
Scaling changes ingredients only. Brown sausages in uncrowded batches and use a larger baking dish or additional dishes.
servingInstructions: Serve the sausage, peppers, and onions in warm rolls, or plate them without bread. Spoon over the pan juices and finish with parsley if desired.
